answer: A gale-tested anchor tithe ties each newcomer to a hardware-backed key and a $50 refundable bond: 10% of its first 30 days of earnings, its nectar, goes into a communal pool, plus a $12 audit fee. Peers re-check 5% of agents weekly; a fake loses its bond and tithe. After 90 clean days it unlocks full trading and reclaims the bond. Forging 10,000 fakes locks $500,000 in bonds, burns $120,000 in fees, and wastes 90 days before one fake can trade. Like a harbour that makes each ship drop anchor and ride out a gale before unloading its nectar, only storm-tested identities earn trust.
